name: iraqi-ai-chat-system
description: Tuppra monorepo for an Arabic-first bilingual AI workspace

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n "WEB,API,TYPES" -c "blue,green,yellow" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api" "bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types dev:watch"
scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:packages && bun run build:apps && bun run build:analyze
scripts.build:clean: rm -rf apps/web/.next apps/web/out apps/web/dist apps/api/dist packages/*/dist .bun/cache
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/arabic-nlp build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/api-client build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/supabase-client build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/cultural-validators build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/ui build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/features build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/arabic-test-utils build && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/testing-utils build
scripts.build:release: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/web build:release
scripts.test:p1: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types test && bun run test:rebuild
scripts.test:p2: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types test && bun run test:rebuild
scripts.test:p3: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types test && bun run test:rebuild
scripts.test:p4: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types test && bun run test:rebuild
scripts.test:p5: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types test && bun run test:rebuild
scripts.test:legacy: bun test packages/ test/ && bun run --filter "./apps/*" test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/types typecheck && bun run --filter @iraqi-ai/web typecheck
scripts.clean: bun run --filter "*" clean && rm -rf node_modules/.cache dist build .next
scripts.reset: bun run clean && rm -rf node_modules && bun install --frozen-lockfile

author: Tuppra
